svg.title: .SYSTEMX — AGENT BETA field guide
svg.desc: Agent Beta records separately named offline BOT or DOT workspaces and advisory task or access links without connecting a provider.
svg.text: Named BOT and DOT workspace records
Set up one named BOT workspace.
Link reviewed intent to a canonical task.
The named folder records identity and task references.
It does not log in, launch a provider or grant access.
